statements.text: The abstract estimate for the construction of the storm water drain in Ward No.14 of Seetharampuram Municipal Corporation allocates Rs.4.20 lakhs for earthwork excavation.
The estimate allocates Rs.61.35 lakhs for 860 m of RCC drain (1.2m x 1.0m).
The estimate allocates Rs.9.80 lakhs for 4 culvert crossings.
The estimate allocates Rs.3.15 lakhs for the shifting of utilities.
